values.meaning: maximum charge duration (seconds until damage/knockup is fully matured)

mechanics.claim: The whirlwind charges for up to 3 seconds, increasing its damage every second; the manual or automatic recast fires the missile that deals the damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Janna''' summons a whirlwind at her current location that charges up over 3 seconds, increasing its range, speed, damage, and {{tip|airborne|knock up}} duration every second over the duration.

mechanics.claim: Damage is dealt only on the recast, when the whirlwind is launched and travels for 1.25 seconds before it can hit the target.
mechanics.quote: '''Janna''' launches the whirlwind in the direction she targeted over {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts when Howling Gale is initially cast, not when it is recast/launched.
Both the initial cast and the manual recast count as separate ability activations, e.g. for triggering on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
